veo.prompt_hint: Write the line/speech directly in the prompt — Gemini Omni will voice it itself (native lip-sync). The portrait below is optional, for a "talking head".
veo.talking_head_desc: A video where the person from your photo looks into the camera and says the text from the prompt — with lip-sync and a natural voice. Great for greetings, video business cards, Reels, and Stories.
veo.preset_talking_head_prompt: A young woman looks warmly into the camera and says: "Hi! Great to see you on Linkeon — here you'll find people who truly get you." Soft daylight, warm tones, natural gestures.
veo.own_voice_hint: Gemini Omni will generate the video, then voice it with your own voice (cloned from your sample). Image quality stays the same, and the lips remain in sync.
veo.own_voice_surcharge: A surcharge of ~{{amount}} tokens on top of the video cost.
veo.tier_hint: Fast — quicker and cheaper. Standard — higher detail, more expensive (~2.7×).
veo.aspect_hint: 9:16 — vertical for social media (Reels, Shorts, Stories, TikTok). 16:9 — horizontal. 9:16 works best for portraits.
veo.resolution_hint: 1080p — higher detail (skin, pores). 720p — faster. In horizontal (16:9) videos of 9–36s the extensions are always 720p, so 1080p is more noticeable on shorter clips. Vertical (9:16) and horizontal videos over 36s are assembled from independent clips, where 1080p works at any length.
veo.length_hint: 16:9 (horizontal): up to 36s — one continuous video, base 8s + 7s extensions; longer ones are assembled from 8s clips. 9:16 (vertical): beyond 8s we automatically assemble the video from several 8s clips. Slight seams are possible where clips join — the line is split across the clips.
veo.vertical_segments_hint: {{sec}}s video — we'll assemble {{count}} 8s clips and stitch them into one video automatically.
veo.portrait_photos_hint: For a "talking head" made from a person's face. Best results come from 3 front-facing photos in different angles/lighting: Gemini Omni achieves a noticeably closer likeness than from a single photo. Without a photo, the scene is generated from the description alone.
veo.portrait_photos_recommend: 💡 We recommend uploading <1>3 photos</1> (different angles) — the facial likeness comes out noticeably better.

faq.q: How do I get started with the platform?
faq.a: After signing in you receive a starter token pack. Pick an assistant and describe your task in your own words. Not sure whom to ask? Start with Roman: your personal assistant will help or tell you which specialist you need.

faq.q: What are tokens and how are they spent?
faq.a: Tokens are the platform's internal currency. They are spent on messages to assistants, image and video generation, voice-overs, voice calls and people search. The cost depends on the complexity of the task — dynamic pricing adapts to the amount of work. You see the spend after every operation.

faq.q: Which assistants are available?
faq.a:
The platform offers two kinds of assistants:

• For business — lawyer, accountant, CFO, marketer, copywriter, designer, sales, business launch, CTO, career consultant
• For personal growth — coach, values exploration, game practitioner, numerologist, Vedic astrologer, Human Design, lifestyle coach
• Personal assistant Roman — helps with any task

You can create your own assistant with its own role and instructions in «Studio» → «Assistants».

faq.q: How does Networking work?
faq.a:
The Networking section has four tabs:

• Find people — enter a query (for example «looking for a designer for an eco-friendly project») and the system will find matches by values, skills and interests.
• Compatibility — enter another user's phone number and the AI will analyze your compatibility. You can also launch the analysis right from a request card or an open chat.
• Requests — incoming and outgoing invitations to talk.
• Chats — accepted conversations with other users.

faq.q: How do I invite someone to chat?
faq.a: From search or compatibility results, open the person's profile and click «Request chat». Write a short intro message (up to 500 characters) — the recipient will see it in «Networking → Requests». You can't send another request until they respond. If they sent you a request first — your request auto-accepts theirs and the chat opens immediately.

faq.q: What do I do with an incoming chat request?
faq.a:
Open Networking → Requests tab. On the card:

• «View profile» — opens the sender's values, interests and skills.
• «Compatibility» — instant AI analysis of the match with your profile.
• «Accept» — a chat is created and you switch to the conversation.
• «Decline» — the request is silently removed, the sender is not notified of the decline.

Limit: up to 10 active outgoing requests and no more than 5 new per hour.

faq.q: How do user-to-user chats work?
faq.a:
Once a request is accepted, the conversation appears in Networking → Chats. In the conversation:

• Messages — plain text up to 4000 characters, with read receipts.
• Avatar and name in the header are clickable — they open the full profile.
• The «three dots» menu in the top right — «View profile», «Compatibility», «Report», «Block».

You can exchange phone numbers and contacts directly in the conversation, if you agree to.

faq.q: How do I report or block a user?
faq.a: In an open chat click the three dots in the top right → «Report» (describe the reason, moderation will review it) or «Block» (after confirmation, the user can no longer message you and you can no longer message them). Requests from blocked users are also not created.

faq.q: How is my profile built?
faq.a: Your profile is built automatically from your conversations with assistants. The AI extracts your values, interests, skills, desires and intentions — they're stored in a graph database and gradually refined. The more you chat, the more accurate your profile and the better search and compatibility results. Assistants learn about your business from the «My business» card in your profile — you can add to it yourself.

faq.q: Can I upload documents?
faq.a: Yes. Click «+» in the chat and attach a file — a document, spreadsheet, presentation or image, up to 10 files at a time. The assistant will work through them right in the conversation (Masha accepts PDF only). Everything the assistant has created in a conversation — images, videos, files — is collected in «Media and files».

faq.q: How do I generate images?
faq.a:
Two ways:

• In the chat — ask the assistant to “draw…” or “create an image…”.
• In the «Image generator» section — enter a description and start the generation.

Standard quality costs 5,000 tokens, HD (4K) — 10,000. A finished image can be edited, combined with others or turned into a video.

faq.q: How do I create a video?
faq.a:
Video section. Clips are made by Gemini Omni — with sound and synced speech out of the box.

• Describe the scene in the prompt field. If someone speaks in the clip, write their line right there: Gemini Omni will say it itself, with matching lip movement.
• Want a video of a specific person? Add up to 3 photos of them from different angles (you can pick from your own images). Without photos the clip is built from the description alone.
• Format — vertical 9:16 for social media or horizontal 16:9, resolution 1080p or 720p, length from 8 to 60 seconds.
• «Voice it with my voice» — the clip will speak in your own voice (you'll need a voice sample).

The token cost is shown on the «Create» button — it depends on length and format. Finished clips appear in the «My videos» tab — you can download them, share them or make them again with the same settings.

faq.q: How do I top up tokens?
faq.a: Click the «Tokens» block in the menu and choose a pack — prices and payment methods are shown in the purchase window. Promo codes give you bonus tokens.

faq.q: What is the partner program?
faq.a: You can invite a friend with the link from the «Invite a friend» block in your profile. The partner program pays a commission on payments made by users you bring in: it is credited automatically and can be withdrawn in tokens or money. To become a partner, contact the administrator.

faq.q: Is my data safe?
faq.a: Yes. We don't share your data with third parties. Other users' phone numbers are hidden — you can only contact them through platform requests and chats. Chat requests require your explicit consent (Accept/Decline). You can block any user and delete your account with all its data at any time from the Profile section.

faq.q: Can I talk to an assistant by voice?
faq.a: Yes. The «Call» button in the chat header (on a phone — the floating button in the assistant list) starts a voice conversation with Roman. Any reply can be played aloud with «Listen» below it, and each assistant's voice can be chosen in «Settings» → «Assistant voices».

faq.q: What is «Studio»?
faq.a:
«Studio» has three tabs:

• «Assistants» — your own assistants with their own role and instructions.
• «Telegram bots» — a bot with an assistant for your Telegram group; you'll need to link your Telegram in your profile.
• «Products» — your website or Telegram bot: domain, server and updates are on Linkeon, and you ask for changes in plain words. The first two products get the first month free (deleted ones count too), then rent is paid in tokens; up to two products per account at a time.

faq.q: How do I connect a calendar and notifications?
faq.a:
«My profile» → «Settings» → «Calendars»: Yandex Calendar, work Outlook, Google and iCloud via a link; Taler ID is connected there too. Assistants will see your schedule and can suggest events as a card — they reach your calendar only after you confirm.

An assistant can also message you at a set time — for example, send you an “energy of the day” every morning. Ask it to, and turn on «Notifications on this device» in «Settings».

faq.q: How do I start a conversation from scratch?
faq.a: Turn on «Fresh start» in the chat header: the assistant won't see your past history and tasks, while your profile keeps growing. Turn it off and the conversation continues with the earlier context.

faq.q: Is there a mobile app?
faq.a: For Android — in «Settings» → «Mobile app»: the app is installed from a file, not via Google Play.

intro.title: A Linkeon assistant in your Telegram group
intro.lead: Pick a role (a ready-made Linkeon assistant or one of your own from the Assistants tab) and a name it will answer to. The assistant replies right in the chat — to text, voice messages and files people send — and can reply by voice too if you want.
intro.why_work: Work chat: a lawyer checks a contract someone sent to the group, an accountant answers tax questions, a copywriter drafts a post.
intro.why_family: Family or friends: plan a trip, work out shared expenses, pick a gift.
intro.why_personal: Your own chat: a group with just you and the bot — your assistant is always at hand in Telegram.
intro.how_link: Link your Telegram — you only need to do this once.
intro.how_setup: Choose a role, a name and when the bot replies: only when someone addresses it, when it decides it's worth chiming in, or to every message.
intro.how_add: Add the bot to your group with the link — it switches on by itself.
intro.cost: Every bot reply is paid for with tokens from your balance — even if another group member asked the question. If you run out of tokens, the bot goes quiet until you top up: it lets anyone who addresses it know why, and messages you directly in Telegram.
intro.note_history: The bot sees the group's messages — that's how it understands what the conversation is about; you can open the chat history on the bot's card.
intro.note_commands: Owner commands in the group: /balance — your balance, /silent — the bot goes quiet, /resume — it replies again.
intro.products: Need a bot of your own for your customers — under your own name in Telegram, taking bookings, collecting requests and answering common questions? That's a product, and an assistant will build it for you.

domain.label: Domain
domain.recordsIntro: Create these records at your domain registrar:
domain.copyFailed: couldn't copy — selected, copy it manually
domain.deleteOthers: Remove all other A records and all AAAA records for these names — otherwise the certificate can't be issued.

errorReasons.taken: While we were waiting for DNS, this domain was connected to another product.
errorReasons.orphan_issuing: Certificate issuing was interrupted: the product stopped or the server didn't respond in time. Press “Check again”.
errorReasons.orphan_removing: Disconnecting was interrupted: the product stopped or the server didn't respond in time. Press “Disconnect” once more.
errorReasons.issue_failed: Let’s Encrypt didn't issue the certificate — most often because of the DNS records. Check them and press “Check again”.
errorReasons.agent_outdated: A temporary failure on Linkeon's side — this attempt doesn't count. Press “Check again” a bit later.

reasons.ip: That's an IP address, but a domain is needed — for example, mysite.com.
reasons.no_dot: Enter the full domain, including the zone — for example, mysite.com.
reasons.bad_form: That doesn't look like a domain. A correct example: mysite.com.
reasons.our_zone: That's a Linkeon address — the product already has it. A custom domain is one you bought from a registrar.
reasons.too_long: The domain is too long (for a root domain, www counts too) — a certificate can't be issued for it. Check for extra parts.
reasons.mixed_script: The domain mixes Cyrillic and Latin letters — the keyboard layout probably switched. Check the spelling.
reasons.unknown_tld: There's no such domain zone — check the ending of the domain (for example, .com, .org, .ru).
reasons.not_found: Product not found — refresh the page.
reasons.bot: A bot has no address — only a site can have a custom domain.
reasons.blocked: The product was stopped by an administrator — you can't connect a domain or issue a certificate.
reasons.not_ready: The product isn't running right now — you can continue with the domain once it's up.
reasons.has_domain: The product already has a custom domain — disconnect it first.
reasons.taken: This domain is already connected to another product.
reasons.no_domain: The product has no custom domain — refresh the page.
reasons.issuing: A certificate is being issued — you can disconnect once it's done (usually under a minute).
reasons.busy: The product is busy with another task — try again in a minute.
reasons.throttled: We just checked — wait half a minute.
reasons.retries: Too many issuing attempts in the last hour — Let’s Encrypt doesn't like frequent retries. Try again in an hour.
